title: THC Cultivation Technician I
occupationalClaim: The credential holder can safely execute routine commercial cultivation work under established SOPs, make required observations and measurements, preserve plant/material identity and traceability, document work accurately, perform permitted operator-level equipment care, and escalate abnormal or unauthorized conditions appropriately.

assessmentModel.passingRule: Development rule only: candidate must meet the provisional written/scenario standard, satisfy all required practical performance criteria, complete the integrated shift capstone, and have no unresolved critical safety failure. Final cut scores require formal standard setting before release.

limitations: Does not confer government licensure, pesticide-applicator authority, or authorization to perform regulated work outside applicable law and facility policy.
Does not certify independent facility design, advanced crop diagnosis, supervisory authority, breeding-program leadership, or engineering-level maintenance.
Platform-specific seed-to-sale proficiency requires the employer or jurisdiction-specific implementation training used by the facility.
